title: MurmurHash3 of long text
summary: Hash ASCII documents of 1 KB to 256 KB with 32-bit MurmurHash3 (x86, seed 0) to an unsigned 32-bit value.
notes: Same algorithm and seed as the short-keys task, but the cost is the per-byte loop over long inputs rather than per-call overhead. Inputs are ASCII so that byte and UTF-16 code unit views agree.
